You can follow these steps if you wanna verify.

1st - Click/tap here —> ⁠2│verify-your-asset 
2nd - Type the following (then hit enter on keyboard) —>  /verify add
3rd - Copy/paste your wallet address or ada handle and hit tab on keyboard
4th - You will be instructed to send a certain amount of ada to yourself. Send that exact amount to your wallet address from your same wallet address
5th - Wait until your wallet has confirmed transaction and you will see that you have been verified at ⁠2│verify-your-asset 
6th - Wait a bit longer and the roles that you have will show up

Note for non-OG members: If you have any rarity GTi but no Bubblejett -  your username will be BLACK. If you have any rarity Bubblejett your username will be RED.
 If you click/tap on the profile pic, it will reveal your roles
